snippet.title: Potatostrike Trailer - Beta 0.7.2
snippet.description:
Starchless has mobilized his massive fleet. He causes terror and destruction wherever he goes.

The only thing standing in his way is the ultimate potato-based space fighter, Potatostrike.

Try out this free indiegame shmup today.

You can find Potatostrike on itch:
https://lmg3864.itch.io/potatostrike

Where to find me and my other games:
https://linktr.ee/lmg3864

Music by WolfRavN:
https://linktr.ee/wolfravn
